subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should `onModelDiagnosticEvent` be accepted as the canonical public cross-provider plugin telemetry API with a documented non-integrity `trusted` marker and the five-event allowlist?
rationale: Related history supports diagnostics as the correct layer, but only maintainers can approve the exact third-party data scope and permanent SDK compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve this diagnostics contract
options.body: Accept the five-event cross-provider observability stream and its documented non-integrity semantics as a stable Plugin SDK API.

options.title: Narrow the event set
options.body: Retain diagnostics delivery but expose only the minimum approved telemetry facts, such as usage-only events.

options.title: Keep bundled-only access
options.body: Continue limiting trusted model lifecycle consumption to approved bundled diagnostics services.

recommendation.title: Approve this diagnostics contract
recommendation.body: Accept the five-event cross-provider observability stream and its documented non-integrity semantics as a stable Plugin SDK API.

likelyOwner.reason: They made the clearest recent decision that model usage belongs in diagnostics rather than a separate provider-scoped API.
